
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/herta/p/19068920" title="发布于 2025-09-01 21:16">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">斜率优化 DP 解析（[HNOI2008] 玩具装箱 题解）</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<p>前置知识：单调队列（一般情况下）、一次函数、前缀和（例题）。</p>
<h2 id="关于">关于</h2>
<p>斜率优化一般解决这样的问题：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[dp_i = \min \{ dp_j + f(i, j) \}
\]</div><p></p><p>当然这种也算：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[dp_i = \max \{ dp_j + f(i, j) \}
\]</div><p></p><h2 id="例题">例题</h2>
<p>链接是这个：跳转到<a href="https://www.luogu.com.cn/problem/P3195" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">洛谷</a>。</p>
<p>题目大意：将一段数组分段，每段的代价是 <span class="math inline">\((j - i + \sum_{k=i}^j{c_k} - L) ^2\)</span>，求分段代价合的最小值。</p>
<h3 id="第一次变形">第一次变形</h3>
<p>令前缀和数组为 <span class="math inline">\(s\)</span>，即：<span class="math inline">\(s_i = \sum_1^i{c_k}\)</span>，则：<span class="math inline">\(\sum_{k=i}^j{c_k} = sum_j - sum_{i - 1}\)</span>。</p>
<p>令：<span class="math inline">\(m = L + 1\)</span>。</p>
<p>则：<span class="math inline">\(dp_i = \min \{ dp_j + (i - j + s_i - s_j +m) \}\)</span>。</p>
<p>继续令：<span class="math inline">\(a_i = i + s_i\)</span>。</p>
<p>则：<span class="math inline">\(dp_i = \min \{ dp_j + (a_i - a_j - m)^2 \}\)</span>。</p>
<p>就是上面关于所提到的类似的式子。</p>
<p>弱版的话直接这样暴力 DP <span class="math inline">\(O(n^2)\)</span> 就能过。</p>
<h3 id="第二次变形">第二次变形</h3>
<p>解决：<span class="math inline">\(dp_i = \min \{ dp_j + (a_i - a_j - m)^2 \}\)</span> 的问题。</p>
<p>假设存在更优解 <span class="math inline">\(j\)</span> 且 <span class="math inline">\(j\)</span> 小于当前最优值 <span class="math inline">\(k\)</span>，即：<span class="math inline">\(j &lt; k\)</span>.</p>
<p>那么很容易得到：<span class="math inline">\(dp_j + (a_i - a_j - m)^2 \le dp_k + (a_i - a_k - m)^2\)</span>。</p>
<p>化解移项（过程略）后得到的结果：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[(dp_j + a_j ^ 2) - (dp_k - a_k^2) \le 2(a_i - m)(a_j - k)
\]</div><p></p><p>令：<span class="math inline">\(f(i) = dp_i + a_i^2\)</span>，可得：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\frac{f(j) - f(k)}{a_j - a_k} \le 2(a_i - m)
\]</div><p></p><p>斜率具有单调性，使用单调队列优化即可。</p>
<h2 id="代码">代码</h2>
<pre><code class="language-cpp">#include &lt;bits/stdc++.h&gt;
#define GCC optimize("Ofast", "-funroll-all-loops")
#pragma GCC target("popcnt")

#define int long long

#define rep(x, a, b) for (auto x = a; x &lt;= b; x++)
#define rpl(x, a, b) for (auto x = a; x &lt; b; x++)
#define per(x, a, b) for (auto x = a; x &gt;= b; x--)

using namespace std;

#define pii pair&lt;int, int&gt;
#define x first
#define y second

const int N = 5e4 + 10;
int n, m, a[N], b[N], s[N], dp[N];
deque&lt;int&gt; q;

int f(int x) { return dp[x] + a[x] * a[x]; }
double slope(int x, int y) { return (double)(f(x) - f(y)) / (a[x] - a[y]); }

signed main()
{
	ios::sync_with_stdio(false); 
	cin.tie(nullptr); 

	cin &gt;&gt; n &gt;&gt; m;
	m ++;
	
	rep(i, 1, n) cin &gt;&gt; s[i];
	rep(i, 2, n) s[i] += s[i - 1];
	rep(i, 1, n) a[i] = s[i] + i;   
	
	q.push_back(0);
	rep(i, 1, n) {
		while (q.size() &gt; 1 &amp;&amp; slope(q[0], q[1]) &lt;= 2 * (a[i] - m)) q.pop_front();		
		dp[i] = dp[q[0]] + (a[i] - a[q[0]] - m) * (a[i] - a[q[0]] - m);		
		while (q.size() &gt; 1 &amp;&amp; slope(q[q.size() - 2], q.back()) &gt; slope(i, q.back())) q.pop_back();
		
		q.push_back(i);
	}
	
	cout &lt;&lt; dp[n] &lt;&lt; endl;
	return 0;
}
</code></pre>

</div>
